title: Repair Main Display landscape clock, four weather slots, and preset radial glow
verify: Before any production write, capture fresh task-scoped RED from the current Main Display source and deterministic host render/geometry probes at exactly 2460x1080 and 1280x720. Record the full HH:mm text bounds and measured width/height, available central/upper bounds, all four weather-slot bounds/order, NO_DATA/async-refresh shell behavior, populated redacted-fixture behavior, and current preset rim/gradient/glow observations. Do not reuse W26 or W28 as current RED; they are terminal historical references only.

Implement only the bounded Main Display correction in DisplayCapability.kt with focused DisplayProjectionTest.kt support: make the full density-safe HH:mm fit the available landscape central/upper area at both host sizes with no clipping or overflow; keep the four Yesterday/today/tomorrow/day-after slots present and geometrically stable through honest NO_DATA and an in-flight/async refresh state as well as a populated redacted fixture; and replace the existing linear white-to-color outline with one preset-color radial shade gradient, a materially wider rim than the current baseline, and a static outward-fading neon glow around each circular preset button.

Obtain claim-equivalent GREEN at both 2460x1080 and 1280x720 using the same deterministic host path and same-size visual receipts. The receipts must distinguish the complete HH:mm string and prove every measured clock bound fits its available region with no clipping/overflow; prove four slots in yesterday/today/tomorrow/day_after order for NO_DATA, async refresh and populated redacted-fixture cases without fabricated weather values, disappearing slots or layout shift; and prove each preset has one radial shade gradient anchored to its existing preset color, a materially wider rim than RED, and a static outward fading glow that does not obscure the clock/cards.

Preserve preset order, labels, existing colors, selected/active styling and touch routing, and preserve Timer & Alert semantics. Preserve the existing Main Display -> Weather Context read-only boundary: do not modify WeatherCapability, any provider/adapter, refresh/freshness semantics, cache/history, normalized data or provider selection. Preserve the existing four-card content/day-night/palette/pressure ownership and existing fullscreen/landscape policy rather than moving it to another owner.

Apply a named Reviewer/visual-QA rubric to the 2460x1080 and 1280x720 RED/GREEN receipts. Record PASS/FAIL and decisive measurements/observations for complete clock readability, no clipping/overflow, four-slot stability in NO_DATA/async/populated redacted fixture, preserved anchors/order, radial preset-color shade identity, wider rim, static outward fading glow, lightweight treatment, and host-versus-target evidence separation. The rubric is evidence, not a T3 checkpoint.

Run the focused display suite, full host unit suite, clean debug build, Android debug lint and git diff check. The focused/full regression evidence must retain device-time HH:mm/date/colon behavior, four ordered display-ready cards, NO_DATA and populated redacted fixture projections, preset labels/colors/selection/touch behavior and Timer & Alert gesture/countdown/overdue/audio behavior without writing or re-owning neighbor state.

Record target/device runtime, physical Samsung GT-I9300I Android 11 custom-ROM behavior, actual 1280x720 device readability/fullscreen/keep-screen-on and any later runtime visual receipt as DEFERRED under the current authorization. Host geometry, host images and static inspection must never become a target-device/runtime PASS; a later explicit authorization must route through the applicable runtime/readiness workflow rather than being silently performed here. Do not launch an emulator/device/runtime, use adb, network or credentials.

Stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-001 if density-safe fitting, materially wider rim, radial shade treatment or outward glow cannot be decided without a new fixed dp/ratio/gradient-stop/visual target. Stop and route to /spec-design if the result needs a new owner, module, graph edge, public contract, dependency, event path, resource/asset pipeline or composition-root orchestration. Stop before any write outside DisplayCapability.kt or DisplayProjectionTest.kt, any WeatherCapability/FoundationRuntime/adapter/Settings/Timer/resource/MainActivity change, any W26/W28 history change, or any lifecycle/scheduler/checkpoint/status/terminal-state change.
